# Astryx Attribution

Source: https://github.com/meta/astryx

Theme Editor is adapted from local upstream commit
`5770e5b197cf80d5a824667c23046887cc8fa0f5`:

- `apps/docsite/src/app/playground/themeEditor/*`
- `apps/docsite/src/lib/useLiveNumberInput.ts`
- `apps/docsite/src/app/playground/defaultCode.ts`

The 58 files under `src/templates/generated/` were generated by the official
`@astryxdesign/cli@0.7.13`; their copyright headers are retained.
Runtime components and seven theme packages are pinned to Astryx `0.7.13`.

Local changes include relative imports, no automatic external font downloads,
accessible native color controls, safe theme-source serialization, local preview
transport, responsive shell sizing, template compatibility adjustments, and a
restricted TypeScript/TSX runner. Edited source is evaluated only inside the
opaque preview iframe through an allowlisted local module resolver; it is never
executed in the parent page and this boundary is not a complete JavaScript
capability sandbox.

See `LICENSE` beside this file for the MIT license. React, StyleX, Lucide,
Heroicons, Recharts, and other dependencies retain their own licenses.
No Astryx/Meta logo or third-party font/image collection is bundled here.
Template fixture placeholders are reference content, not mybot business facts.
mybot is not an official Meta or Astryx product.
